verdict.rationale: Ubuntu provides official step-by-step tutorials covering installation and interface exploration (ubuntu-docs-9), plus supporting guides like bootable USB creation, disk encryption, and other setup topics (ubuntu-docs-10 through ubuntu-docs-28), directly matching the switcher's need for guided install and desktop-learning content. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that these tutorials are beginner-friendly/effective for switchers, and no evidence of interactive or video-based onboarding beyond text docs.
